PRODUCT OVERVIEW

Built for Oversized Cargo · Large Gooseneck · T700C Steel · Multiple Axles

The EHJ9400TDP uses a large gooseneck and lowered deck, as low as 950 mm, for construction machinery, concrete pump trucks, rollers, piling equipment and electrical equipment.

FUWA 13 / 16 t heavy-duty axles and 12R22.5 radial tires can be paired with air or mechanical suspension, with heavy-load configurations up to 80 t+. Xiangqi is listed in China's vehicle type-approval catalog; the company undertakes national key equipment projects and provides factory-direct sales and after-sales support across 30+ provincial regions.

FEATURES

Key Features

Five Structural Features · Built for Oversized Transport

01 GOOSENECK

Large-Gooseneck Drop Deck

The large-gooseneck frame lowers the deck to 950mm, helping accommodate tall excavators, pump trucks and piling equipment. Transport permits depend on the loaded dimensions and route.

02 MAIN BEAM

T700C High-Strength Main Beams

12 mm web plates and 10 mm flange plates are welded into T700C high-strength main beams for 80 t+ heavy-load configurations, with reinforced side beams and lower channels.

03 AXLES

Heavy-Duty Multi-Axle Layout

Choose 3–6 FUWA 13 / 16 t heavy-duty axles with air or mechanical suspension to suit the load and operating conditions.

04 RAMP

Optional Hydraulic Ramps

Hydraulically adjustable ramps, mechanical ramps and detachable loading plates allow excavators and loaders to drive on and off, reducing handling time and reliance on lifting equipment.

05 SAFETY

Dual Braking + ABS

Air brakes (4 dual + 2 single chambers), KOMEE ABS and an emergency brake provide controlled braking on loaded descents for long-distance heavy-load transport.
